new_design_constraints.onnx_execution_policy: Independent zero-tolerance validation of a candidate already produced by the authoritative exact verifier only; never candidate generation, search, ranking, or repair.
new_design_constraints.solved_count_credit_source: Verifier-internal abstract reasoning, exact ReLU semantics, certified constraints, and exact solver outcomes only.
new_design_constraints.rare_cases: Reject at bounded preflight and return UNKNOWN; do not add a slow computational fallback.
required_execution_shape: one independent forward witness when a candidate exists
forbidden_redundancy: primary core plus full solver sidecar
native source plus simultaneously retained expanded legacy source
repeated Python Fraction transform on the timed common path
second full auxiliary-row replay after solve
new_design_constraints.rollback_policy: Legacy and experimental implementations may be separate explicit configurations, but the selected runtime must never build both and switch silently.

implementation_budget.common_path_specialization_rule: A specialization is admissible only when it replaces work in the selected path; it may not coexist with a runtime fallback for the same request.
implementation_budget.unsupported_policy: A bounded preflight returns UNKNOWN before expensive allocation or solver work.

implementation_guidance.hot_path: Optimize the measured high-frequency CIFAR/Tiny structure first, especially direct A_bin.nnz==0 ADD/RANGE blocks and Conv affine construction.
implementation_guidance.rare_numeric_or_backend_case: Use a small exact preflight predicate and return UNKNOWN when it fails.
implementation_guidance.soundness_testing: Keep hostile tests to prove rejection and primary-exception preservation, but do not introduce matching production fallback branches.
implementation_guidance.frontend_responsiveness: Measure from cold request entry through the first usable verified/UNKNOWN response; exclude no setup that the caller actually waits for.

next_action: Preserve the projection-skip structural deletion and stop frontend micro-optimizations, additional linear ReLU formulations, floating-point solver wrappers, restored bytecode candidates, and toy-family production branches. The remaining blocker is the absence of one proof-capable exact MIP/certificate mechanism that can admit the 11k-column C100 model and return a checked result inside the cold budget. Any future implementation must replace the selected native solve rather than coexist with it, preserve one exact binary phase per unstable ReLU, use no triangle/ACT-BaB/backward/dual/sampling/PGD/fallback path, and cross the CIFAR100 bounded-result and concurrency gates before any TinyImageNet run.
